note: Inyo NF campground in the town of June Lake off Hwy 158, in aspen and pine above the east shore of June Lake; a few sites have filtered lake views, and the marinas, stores and restaurants are a short walk. Only about seven sites take a 23-ft rig (most RV sites are posted at 20 ft), so check the site's length before booking. Every site has a bear locker, and all food and scented items must go in it. --Claude
summary: June Lake (Inyo NF, concessionaire): $32 + tax confirmed, $10 extra vehicle, 28 sites (21 RV/trailer + 7 tent), only 7 RV sites 25-60 ft, the rest 20 ft; no hookups, flush toilets, water; season from late April (2027-04-23); lakeview kept (filtered view in a rec.gov campsite photo; sites 110 m+ from shore behind road/marina/parking).
flags: WATERFRONT (lakeview kept): nearest RV sites (006-008, 20 ft) are ~110-130 m from June Lake with the campground road, marina buildings and parking between; not on-water. A rec.gov campsite photo shows the lake through brush, which supports the stored lakeview (filtered view from sites is enough for a *view).
